primary: Equal-block recipient-task success: same_task minus opposite_task > 0
primary_failure: A zero or negative point difference fails the directional prediction in this development panel; uncertainty and all blocks remain mandatory.
secondary_content_replacement: Equal-block opposite-task success: opposite_task minus same_task > 0
controls: matched target magnitudes and common support
same donor pair, history and recipient index
full own hybrid for support restriction
ordinary_rivals: Fixed 64-step signed linear transport orders donor hybrids
rival_score: Equal-block mean of preference times paired recipient-task success difference; discordant-read accuracy with half-credit for predicted ties is descriptive.
units: Eight exposed blocks, 64 selected failures, sixteen fresh mask/noise draws; one original-mask control draw.
selection: All prior cases; deterministic donors from other founder pair; common support only; no native-outcome filter.
endpoint: Both cues and both output ports strictly exceed 0.25 after alignment, using last-32 means at 2048 updates; separately evaluate the opposite mapping.
uncertainty: Paired whole-block descriptive bootstrap, 20000 draws, fixed seed 2026101003; no equivalence claim from zero-containing intervals.
interpretation: Task-related sign compatibility or replacement in this selected cohort. Distinguish nominal teaching from measured donor competence; no unique RDT, full complementary body-record information, autonomy or population-generalization claim.
resource_boundary: Fixed supplied reader, incoming-record and donor access, shared cue randomness, equal output byte count without total resource equivalence.
